wiki_pages_written.title: FRI Decomposition — Magnitude vs Direction in Equity Mean Reversion
wiki_pages_written.summary: Portnaya (2026) FRI decomposition: SPY lag-1 autocorrelation entirely magnitude-driven (p<1e-12), sign channel not significant (p=0.11). Validates IBS mechanism, grounds H428 filter design, establishes where NOT to apply mean reversion (credit/commodities/crypto).
